rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that causes great sadness or suffering.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zan1 hai6 caam2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the situation is sad or lamentable rather than simply terrible.

example.english: They turned against each other over money; it’s truly tragic.
example.traditional: 佢哋為咗錢反目，真係可悲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 cin2 faan2 muk6 zan1 hai6 ho2 bei1

rows.note: Use this for a painful tragedy, especially one involving serious loss or suffering.

example.english: This accident made the whole family suffer a tragic loss.
example.traditional: 呢場意外令成家人承受慘痛損失。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6 ling6 seng4 gaa1 jan4 sing4 sau6 caam2 tung3 syun2 sat1
